title: Trademark registration
summary: File a trademark application (Form TM-A) with IP India; after examination it is published in the Trade Marks Journal, where third parties may oppose within 4 months.

authority.name: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (IP India)

steps.title: File the trademark application (TM-A)
steps.description: Search existing marks, pick the class(es), file Form TM-A online and pay the fee; then track examination, reply to objections and attend a hearing if scheduled.

forms.name: Application for registration of a trademark

documents.name: Trademark representation (word or logo) and description of goods/services

fee.note: E-filing, per class and per mark: ₹4,500 for an individual, startup or small enterprise; ₹9,000 in all other cases (physical filing ₹5,000 / ₹10,000).

officialSla.note: IP India states no total processing time.

conditional.condition: After publication in the Trade Marks Journal, third parties may oppose within 4 months

duration.note: 4-month opposition window; opposition proceedings have no fixed end.

review.note: Checked 2026-09-28, IP India Forms & Official Fees: "Individual / Startup/Small Enterprise 5,000 4,500" (physical / e-filing); filing process: "Third parties may oppose within 4 months".

steps.title: Trademark registered
steps.description: Registration after acceptance, publication and any opposition proceedings.
